title: 2025年6月 第2套
passage: 粤港澳大湾区(Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area)具有得天独厚的地理位置，拥有完善的交通基础设施和丰富的产业资源。大湾区是中国开放程度最高、经济活力最强的区域之一，在国家经济发展中具有重要的战略地位。大湾区不仅将建成充满活力的世界级城市群和具有全球影响力的国际科技创新中心，还将打造成适合工作、购物、旅游的优质生活圈。随着改革开放的不断深入，大湾区的建设将进一步推动区域经济发展。到2035年，大湾区将实现成为国际一流湾区的目标。
reference: The Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area is endowed with exceptional geographic location, well-developed transportation infrastructure, and abundant industrial resources. As one of China's most open and economically vibrant regions, the Greater Bay Area holds significant strategic importance in the nation's economic development. It will be developed not only into a dynamic world-class city cluster and an international technology innovation hub with global influence, but also into a high-quality living circle ideal for working, shopping, and tourism. With the deepening of reform and opening-up, the construction of the Greater Bay Area will further propel regional economic growth. By 2035, the Greater Bay Area will achieve its goal of becoming a world-class bay area.
points: 第一句为简单句，“具有……地理位置”和“拥有……产业资源”语义并列且动作一致，可共用一个谓语动词；“具有得天独厚的”译为be endowed with，三个宾语并列，用and 连接，第二个宾语前加well-developed 等定语。
第二句以“大湾区是……区域之一”为状语，用as 介词短语前置译出；“在国家经济发展中具有重要的战略地位”为主干，译为holds significant strategic importance in the nation's economic development，注意介词in 的搭配。

第三句用“不仅……还……”结构，译为not only...but also...；两个并列名词短语分别译作a dynamic world-class city cluster 和an international technology innovation hub with global influence；“适合工作、购物、旅游的优质生活圈”定语较长，译后置为a high-quality living circle ideal for working, shopping, and tourism。
第四句“随着改革开放的不断深入”作伴随状语，译为with 介词短语With the deepening of reform and opening-up；主句“大湾区的建设将进一步推动区域经济发展”译为the construction of the Greater Bay Area will further propel regional economic growth。
第五句表示将来目标，用一般将来时；“到2035年”译为By 2035，主句译为the Greater Bay Area will achieve its goal of becoming a world-class bay area。
source: 2025年06月CET6题+解+音频/3.2025年06月六级真题（新更）/2025.06英语六级解析第2套.pdf
